prompt:
You are the communication step of RiceBridge Ops, an irrigation agent for a 6-field rice cluster that shares one pump station in An Giang.

Deterministic tools have ALREADY computed the plan (water balance, crop-stage safety, pump capacity). You must not change any action, order, date or number. Your job:
1. headline_en / headline_vi: one sentence each that tells the pump-station manager what the plan does and the single most important reason, combining the events in INPUT.recent_events.
2. explain_en: 2-3 plain-English sentences for a non-expert audience on why the order is what it is (use the reasons given).
3. messages: one chat message per field in INPUT.rows (same fid), short (max 2 sentences), polite southern Vietnamese (anh/chị, nhé), plus English. Say clearly whether to open the inlet (and when HTX calls) or keep it closed and wait. For F3 (Bà Sáu, no smartphone) write the message to the HTX officer asking him to tell bà Sáu. If a row has measure_first true, ask HTX to measure that field before opening the inlet.

Hard constraint: every number you write must appear in INPUT (levels, dates, field numbers, mm). Do not invent yields, money, emissions or percentages.

Reply with ONE JSON object only, no prose, no code fence. It must match this JSON schema:
{"type": "object", "required": ["headline_en", "headline_vi", "explain_en", "messages"], "properties": {"headline_en": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 240}, "headline_vi": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 240}, "explain_en": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 600}, "messages": {"type": "array", "minItems": 1, "items": {"type": "object", "required": ["fid", "text_vi", "text_en"], "properties": {"fid": {"type": "string", "enum": ["F1", "F2", "F3", "F4", "F5", "F6"]}, "text_vi": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 260}, "text_en": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 300}}}}}}

data.headline_en: Pump run Fri 06 Mar opens F4 first (after HTX measures it), then F6, because both need standing water soon; F1, F2, F3 and F5 wait since today's 40.7 mm of rain will refill them.
data.headline_vi: Lượt bơm Fri 06 Mar mở cống F4 trước (sau khi HTX đo mực nước), rồi F6, vì hai thửa này sắp cần nước đứng; F1, F2, F3, F5 chờ vì mưa 40.7 mm hôm nay sẽ bù nước.
data.explain_en: F4 goes first because it starts flowering on Sat 07 Mar and would have no standing water (projected −0.2 cm). Its last reading is 6 days old, so HTX should measure it before opening the inlet. F6 is second because its top-dressing window on Mon 09 Mar needs standing water. F1, F2, F3 and F5 hold because today's 40.7 mm of rain will lift their levels by tomorrow, so no pumping is needed.

messages.text_vi: Anh Hùng (HTX) ơi, nhờ anh ra đo mực nước thửa F4 (Hộ thửa 4) trước, rồi mở cống thứ tự 1 nhé; thửa sắp trổ hoa ngày Sat 07 Mar mà đang thiếu nước đứng.
messages.text_en: HTX, please measure F4 (Hộ thửa 4) first, then open the inlet as queue 1; it starts flowering on Sat 07 Mar and lacks standing water.

messages.text_vi: Chị Hộ thửa 6 ơi, thửa F6 được mở cống ở thứ tự 2 trong lượt bơm Fri 06 Mar nhé; HTX sẽ gọi báo giờ mở, để kịp bón thúc ngày Mon 09 Mar.
messages.text_en: F6 (Hộ thửa 6): your inlet opens as queue 2 in the Fri 06 Mar run, and HTX will call with the time, ready for top-dressing on Mon 09 Mar.

messages.text_vi: Anh/chị Hộ thửa 1 ơi, thửa F1 cứ giữ cống đóng và chờ nhé; mưa 40.7 mm hôm nay sẽ đưa mực nước từ +4.1 cm lên khoảng +7.5 cm.
messages.text_en: F1 (Hộ thửa 1): keep the inlet closed and wait; today's 40.7 mm of rain lifts the level from +4.1 cm to about +7.5 cm.
